info.title: RUN Transcript Management API
info.description: API for Redeemer's University transcript processing, payments, degree verification, and admin management.

get.description: Returns a list of all admin users. Supports filtering by search term, status, and role.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by email, surname, or firstname

post.description: Registers a new admin user with the specified email and role.
Toggles an admin user's account status between ACTIVE and INACTIVE.
Changes the role of an admin user. Cannot change your own role.

422.description: Cannot change your own role or validation error

post.summary: Perform bulk action on admin users
post.description: Performs a bulk action (activate, deactivate, delete, or change_role) on the specified admin users. Your own account is automatically excluded.

422.description: Validation error or no valid users selected

post.description: Sets all admin accounts (except the current user) to ACTIVE status.

message.example: All admin accounts have been activated.

get.description: Returns all pending admin access requests, ordered by most recently updated.

post.description: Approves a pending admin access request, creating the admin account with the specified role.

message.example: Access granted. User can now log in.

post.description: Rejects a pending admin access request.

delete.description: Permanently removes an admin user and revokes all their tokens. Cannot delete your own account.

get.summary: List application settings, optionally filtered by group
List all complaints with applicant details (paginated)

200.description: Paginated list of forgot matric requests

post.summary: Treat a forgot matric number request

get.description: Returns a paginated list of official applications with status PENDING.

200.description: Paginated list of pending official applications

get.description: Returns a paginated list of official applications with status RECOMMENDED.

200.description: Paginated list of recommended official applications

get.description: Returns a paginated list of official applications with status APPROVED.

200.description: Paginated list of approved official applications

get.description: Returns a paginated list of official applications with status FAILED.

200.description: Paginated list of failed official applications

get.description: Returns a paginated list of student applications with status PENDING.

200.description: Paginated list of pending student applications

get.description: Returns a paginated list of student applications with status RECOMMENDED.

200.description: Paginated list of recommended student applications

get.description: Returns a paginated list of student applications with status APPROVED.

200.description: Paginated list of approved student applications

post.description: Marks an application as recommended.
Reverses the recommendation status of an application.
Approves a transcript application.
Disapproves a transcript application.
Regenerates the transcript document for an application.
Sends correction data for a specific application identified by appid. All fields except appid are treated as correction key-value pairs.

appid.description: Application ID to send corrections for

corrections.description: Additional correction fields as key-value pairs

get.description: Returns the raw transcript HTML for an official or student application.

html.description: Decoded HTML content of the transcript

post.description: Downloads a PDF file for an approved official application. The index parameter selects the document: 0 = cover page, 1 = transcript, 2 = certificate.
Creates a new transcript application on behalf of a student. Returns the generated transcript HTML and application ID.

html.description: Decoded HTML content of the generated transcript

post.description: Performs a verify or reject action on courier details submitted for an official application. The applicant is notified of the outcome.

404.description: Application not found or courier not in submitted state

get.description: Returns the courier receipt file inline for the given application.

404.description: Application not found or receipt file missing

post.description: Downloads the generated PDF for an admin-initiated application.
Authenticate an admin user and return an access token.
Create a new admin account with the given email and role.

message.example: The email has already been taken.

get.description: Return the profile of the currently authenticated admin.

post.description: Change the authenticated admin's password by providing the old password and a new one.
Invalidate the current admin's access token.

get.summary: Get dashboard statistics including services, revenue, charts, and recent activities
Get monthly transcript activity counts (array of 12 integers)

200.description: Paginated list of pending degree verifications
Paginated list of recommended degree verifications
Paginated list of approved degree verifications

get.summary: List all payment items (approver/super admin only)

put.summary: Update a payment item (approver/super admin only)

post.summary: Upload student results for a session/semester
post.description: Batch upload or update student results. Creates missing students, courses, and session settings on the fly.

student.description: Student data — only needed if student doesn't exist yet

get.description: Fetch all results or filter by matric number for a given session and semester.
Returns all session/semester combinations that have been configured.

post.summary: Update a student's matric number across all tables
post.description: Changes a student's matric number in t_student_test and cascades the update to registrations, applicants, official_applications, student_applications, admin_applications, and payment_transaction.
Set or unset the flag_waver field on registrations. Flagged records are excluded from GPA/CGPA computation and transcripts.

semester.description: Optional — omit to flag all semesters

course_code.description: Optional — omit to flag all courses

post.summary: Validate matric numbers and course codes before uploading
post.description: Checks which matric numbers and course codes exist on the portal. Does not write any data.
Marks a result as deleted (sets deleted='Y'). Does not permanently remove the record.

post.summary: Batch import or update student records
post.description: Upserts student records — creates new students and updates existing ones, matched on matric_number.

students.description: Array of student records to import

post.summary: Batch promote students to a new level
post.description: Updates student records with new level and academic status. Students are matched by matric_number.

get.summary: Check transcript availability for a destination
get.description: Checks whether the authenticated applicant can request a transcript for the given destination.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination identifier to check availability for

get.summary: Get all destinations and their amounts
get.description: Returns the list of available transcript destinations and their associated fees. This endpoint is public and does not require authentication.

post.description: Submits a new official, student, or proficiency transcript application with payment reference and optional certificate upload.

recipient_email.description: Recipient email for soft copy delivery

get.description: Returns all official transcript applications submitted by the authenticated applicant.
Returns all student transcript applications submitted by the authenticated applicant.
Returns all payments made by the authenticated applicant.
Returns counts of successful, pending, and failed applications for the authenticated applicant.

post.summary: Submit a complaint about student data
post.description: Allows the authenticated applicant to submit a complaint with an optional attachment. Admin team is notified via email.

message.example: My CGPA is listed as 3.2 but should be 3.5.
Your complaint has been submitted. The admin team will review it shortly.

get.description: Returns all complaints submitted by the authenticated applicant.

post.summary: Submit courier details for an application
post.description: Submits courier pickup details and receipt for a pending official transcript application.

courier_receipt.description: Receipt file (jpg, jpeg, png, or pdf, max 5MB)

404.description: Application not found or not in pending courier status

post.description: Edits an official transcript application using a one-time edit token. Can also be used to check token validity before submitting changes.

requestType.description: Use 'check_token' to validate, or 'edit' to submit changes

404.description: Application not found or invalid token

post.description: Creates a new applicant account linked to an existing student record and returns an auth token.
Authenticates an applicant by matric number and password, returning an auth token.

get.description: Returns the authenticated applicant's profile and linked student record.

post.description: Allows the authenticated applicant to change their password by providing the old password.
Sends a password reset link to the applicant's email address if the account exists.

message.example: If this email exists, a reset link has been sent.

post.description: Resets the applicant's password using a previously issued reset token.

post.summary: Submit a forgot matric number request
post.description: Submits a request to recover a forgotten matric number using personal details.
Revokes the current access token, logging the applicant out.

post.summary: Check for pending degree payment RRR
post.description: Check if there is a pending degree payment transaction for the given matric number and institution.
Log a new degree payment transaction record.

get.description: Retrieve payment gateway configuration for degree verification payments.

post.description: Re-query and update the status of a degree payment by its reference.
Re-query the status of a degree payment transaction by RRR.

post.summary: Process Remita bank payment callback for degree
post.description: Process a Remita bank transfer payment callback for degree verification.
Initiate a payment transaction via Interswitch or Remita gateway.
Verify a payment transaction status via Interswitch or Remita.
Webhook endpoint for Interswitch payment notifications. No authentication required.
Check if the applicant has a pending payment transaction for the given destination.
Log a new payment transaction record for the authenticated applicant.

get.description: Retrieve payment gateway configuration for the given destination and gateway.

post.description: Verify and update the status of a payment by its reference.
Re-query the status of a payment transaction via Interswitch or Remita.
Process a Remita bank transfer payment callback.
Webhook endpoint for Remita payment notifications. No authentication required.
Verify a transcript using the token and matric number. No authentication required.

get.description: Download a transcript PDF file by token and document index. No authentication required.

post.description: Submit a new degree verification request. No authentication required.

get.description: Retrieve a list of available programmes. No authentication required.
Retrieve a complete list of programmes. No authentication required.
Retrieve a paginated list of students with optional search, programme, and status filters.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by matric number, surname, or firstname

post.description: Create a new student or update an existing one by matric number (upsert).

get.description: Retrieve a single student record by ID.

put.description: Update an existing student record by ID.

delete.description: Delete a student record by ID.

post.description: Update the status of multiple students at once by matric numbers.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of course registrations with optional filters.

post.description: Create a new course registration or update an existing one (upsert by matric_number, session_id, semester, course_code).

get.description: Retrieve a single course registration record by ID.

put.description: Update an existing course registration record by ID.

delete.description: Delete a course registration record by ID.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of courses with optional search filter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by course code or title

post.description: Create a new course or update an existing one by course code (upsert).

put.description: Update an existing course record by ID.

delete.description: Delete a course record by ID.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of departments with optional search filter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by prog code, programme, department, or college

post.description: Create a new department or update an existing one by programme code (upsert).

put.description: Update an existing department record by ID.

delete.description: Delete a department record by ID.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of settings with optional session filter.

post.description: Create a new setting record.

put.description: Update an existing setting record by ID.

delete.description: Delete a setting record by ID.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of course pass marks with optional search filter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by course code or programme

post.summary: Create or update a pass mark
post.description: Create a new course pass mark or update an existing one (upsert by course_code and programme).

put.description: Update an existing course pass mark record by ID.

delete.description: Soft-delete a course pass mark record by ID.

get.description: Retrieve courses a student has failed and not yet passed (outstanding courses).

post.description: Update the status (and optionally graduation session) of one or more students by matric number.
